    {

      "name": "NumStability.constantCoefficientScalarMatrix",
      "interpretation": "Constructs the one-by-one real matrix whose sole entry is speed.",
      "effect_on_target": "Instantiates A with the constant scalar transport coefficient.",
      "source_match": "Matches the m = 1 reduction of A and constant velocity in equation (1.2).",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01_equation01_constantLinearSystemAt",
      "interpretation": "An abbreviation for the pointwise constant-coefficient system solution predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "The left side asserts derivative existence and the system equation for the embedded scalar function.",
      "source_match": "Matches the classical equation (1.1) specialized to one component.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "NumStability.leveque01_equation02_scalarAdvectionAt",
      "interpretation": "An abbreviation for IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt with real-valued q.",
      "effect_on_target": "The right side is a pointwise classical advection solution predicate.",
      "source_match": "Its equation matches (1.2), but placing it in an equivalence does not assert that transported concentration satisfies it.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "NumStability.scalarAsOneComponentSystem",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt",
      "interpretation": "There exist qt and qx that are respectively derivatives of the time and space slices at t and x, and qt + speed • qx = 0.",

      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "NumStability.IsConstantCoefficientLinearSystemSolutionAt._proof_1",
      "reuse_sha256": "d8321c6a827f9411a900d2f1f382b3b341cb28f478df2fa0d6717c52e6294889",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies continuity of scalar multiplication for the vector-valued derivative machinery.",
      "source_match": "Uses the ordinary topology and action on real vectors; imposes no hypothesis on q.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "NumStability.IsLinearAdvectionSolutionAt._proof_1",
      "interpretation": "For a real normed vector space, its displayed scalar action is jointly continuous in the norm-induced topologies.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the continuity instance required by HasDerivAt on Real.",
      "source_match": "Supports ordinary real calculus without adding regularity assumptions on q.",
      "status": "pass"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "Iff",

    },
